title: Project Administration & Coordination Officer
description:
**Project Administration & Coordination Officer**

**Company:**
ABBA Builders

**Project:**
The 5th Avenue – Climate-Resilient Villas

**Location:**
Kuriachira, Thrissur, Kerala

**Required Joining Date:**
On or before 1 November 2026

**Experience:**
3–5 years of relevant experience preferred

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**1. Position Overview**

ABBA Builders is looking for a mature, qualified, responsible, and well-organised professional to manage the administrative and coordination activities of its climate-resilient villa project,
*The 5th Avenue*
, in Thrissur.

The role involves managing project documentation, coordinating with petty contractors and suppliers, liaising with government departments whenever required, supporting the Sales & Marketing Team, and ensuring the smooth execution of day-to-day project activities.

The ideal candidate should be self-disciplined, trustworthy, proactive, and capable of taking positive decisions within authorised limits while strictly following company policies, procedures, and management instructions.

The position requires a hands-on professional who can independently manage multiple small but important activities without constant supervision.

**About ABBA Builders**

ABBA Builders is part of a global business group with
**39 years of business excellence**
, built on a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

Pioneering a new approach to sustainable property development in Kerala, ABBA Builders has developed
**The 5th Avenue – Climate-Resilient Villas**
in Thrissur, with a focus on creating thoughtfully designed homes that respond to Kerala’s changing climatic conditions.

Our vision is to promote sustainable living through climate-conscious design, energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and quality construction. By integrating climate resilience with contemporary living, ABBA Builders aims to contribute to a more sustainable future for residential real estate in Kerala.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Administration & Documentation**

* Manage day-to-day administrative activities related to the villa project.
* Maintain systematic records of agreements, quotations, work orders, invoices, bills, vouchers, correspondence, and other project documents.
* Ensure that documents are properly verified, approved, filed, and submitted within the prescribed timelines.
* Maintain updated records of contractor details, work status, pending activities, and administrative requirements.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all important transactions and communications.

**B. Contractor & Supplier Coordination**

* Coordinate with petty contractors, suppliers, and service providers for ongoing villa project activities.
* Communicate work instructions and follow up on assigned tasks, completion schedules, material requirements, and pending works.
* Coordinate with contractors to ensure timely completion of assigned work and rectification of identified deficiencies.
* Maintain contractor-wise records of work completed, bills submitted, payments pending, and outstanding activities.
* Ensure that all work commitments and instructions are consistent with management approvals.

**C. Government Department & External Coordination**

* Visit and coordinate with relevant government departments, local authorities, utility providers, and other agencies whenever required.
* Handle authorised submissions, document collection, follow-ups, and routine administrative formalities.
* Maintain records of applications, acknowledgements, correspondence, approvals, and pending matters.
* Ensure that official requirements are followed up systematically and delays are brought to management's attention.
* Ensure that no commitments or representations are made on behalf of the company beyond the authority delegated.

**D. Financial Documentation & Expense Control**

* Check contractor bills, supplier invoices, petty cash vouchers, and expense claims for accuracy and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for bill processing, payment documentation, and reconciliation of records.
* Maintain records of project expenses, outstanding bills, advances, and payment status.
* Ensure that all expenses are properly documented and approved in accordance with company policy.
* Report discrepancies, unsupported claims, or irregularities to management promptly.
* Do not make financial commitments or authorise payments without the required approval.

**E. Site Administration, Housekeeping & Snagging Coordination**

* Coordinate with the site team and housekeeping personnel to maintain the villas and project premises in an orderly and presentable condition.
* Follow up with petty contractors on pending snagging, maintenance, and rectification works.
* Maintain a villa-wise snagging and pending-work register and update the status of each item.
* Ensure that issues identified during inspections or customer visits are communicated to the relevant persons and followed up until closure.
* Escalate delays or quality-related concerns to management for appropriate action.

**F. Sales & Marketing Team Support**

* Provide administrative and operational support to the Sales & Marketing Team for villa promotion and sales activities.
* Coordinate with the sales team to arrange site visits for prospective customers and ensure that the villas are ready for inspection.
* Facilitate the availability of property documents, specifications, photographs, and other project-related information required for sales activities.
* Coordinate with the site team and contractors to address customer observations, snagging issues, and rectification requirements promptly.
* Support the coordination of customer visits, property presentation, and other approved marketing activities at the project site.
* Follow up on administrative requirements communicated by the sales team and ensure timely action.
* Maintain effective communication between the management, Sales & Marketing Team, and project site to facilitate a positive customer experience.

**G. Reporting & Management Coordination**

* Submit daily or periodic reports on completed activities, pending tasks, contractor follow-ups, expenses, and issues requiring management attention.
* Maintain a clear action tracker showing responsibilities, target dates, and completion status.
* Communicate important developments, delays, and operational issues to management without waiting for reminders.
* Ensure that instructions received from management are implemented accurately and within the agreed timelines.
* Maintain confidentiality of company documents, financial information, customer details, and business matters.

**3. Candidate Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate in any discipline; qualifications in Commerce, Business Administration, or Accounting will be an advantage.
* Preferably 3–5 years of experience in construction, real estate, project administration, or a similar operational role.
* Practical knowledge of invoices, bills, vouchers, expense documentation, contractor coordination, and general office administration.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, email, and digital document management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Fluency in Malayalam is essential; basic English communication skills are preferred.
* Willingness to travel locally for site visits, contractor meetings, and government-related work.
* **A valid two-wheeler driving licence and own motorcycle/bike are mandatory.**

**4. Required Personal Attributes**

The successful candidate must demonstrate:

* **Maturity and responsibility:**
  Ability to handle routine operational matters with sound judgement.
* **Integrity and trustworthiness:**
  Responsible handling of company funds, documents, and confidential information.
* **Discipline and compliance:**
  Strict adherence to company policies, procedures, and management instructions.
* **Positive decision-making:**
  Ability to resolve routine issues independently within delegated authority.
* **Proactive follow-up:**
  Ensuring that assigned activities are completed on time without repeated reminders.
* **Organisation and accuracy:**
  Maintaining proper records and managing multiple activities systematically.
* **Coordination skills:**
  Maintaining effective working relationships with contractors, suppliers, government departments, and internal teams.
* **Customer orientation:**
  Supporting the Sales & Marketing Team in maintaining the project and villas in a customer-ready condition.

**5. Performance Expectations**

Performance will be assessed against the following parameters:

1. Timely and accurate maintenance of administrative and financial documentation.
2. Effective follow-up and coordination with contractors, suppliers, and external agencies.
3. Timely closure of pending housekeeping, snagging, and rectification activities.
4. Quality and timeliness of reporting to management.
5. Effective administrative support to the Sales & Marketing Team.
6. Compliance with company policies, approval procedures, and management instructions.
7. Ability to work independently, take appropriate decisions, and demonstrate accountability.

**6. Reporting & Authority**

The Project Administration & Coordination Officer will report to the designated management representative.

The employee is expected to exercise initiative in routine matters while obtaining prior approval for financial commitments, contractual decisions, deviations from company policy, and other matters beyond delegated authority.

**7. Application & Joining Requirements**

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements should submit their updated CV along with:

* Current salary and expected salary.
* Notice period and earliest available joining date.
* Summary of relevant construction or real estate experience.
* Confirmation of possession of a valid two-wheeler driving licence and own motorcycle/bike.

**Required joining date: On or before 1 November 2026.**

ABBA Builders seeks a dependable professional who can take ownership of day-to-day administration and coordination, follow established procedures, and contribute positively to the smooth operation and successful sale of its climate-resilient villas.

title: Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung eines systematischen stufenweise didaktischen Konzepts im Bereich der Quantenbildung

title: Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**
Storibod Creatives is a visual storytelling studio focused on crafting immersive narratives through motion, animation, and graphic design. The team combines creative concepts with strong visual execution to bring stories to life across digital and traditional media. Storibod Creatives encourages innovative thinking and collaboration, inviting team members to contribute ideas that push creative boundaries. Applicants joining the company become part of a growing “visual revolution,” working on projects that blend artistry, technology, and audience engagement.

This is a full-time, on-site Content Writer role based in Ernakulam. The Content Writer will develop clear, engaging written content that supports motion, animation, and graphic design projects, including website copy, campaign narratives, scripts, and social media content. Responsibilities include conducting research to inform content, collaborating with designers and animators to shape cohesive stories, and adapting messaging for different audiences and platforms. The Content Writer will also support content planning, contribute ideas during creative brainstorming sessions, and meet project deadlines in a fast-paced studio environment.

* Candidates should possess strong Writing and Web Content Writing skills for digital platforms and creative projects.

title: Senior Business Process Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Corprights is a comprehensive provider of business finance, tax, and legal services with a strong focus on the Saudi Arabian market. The company specializes in business setup, trademark registration, accounting, financial advisory, and corporate legal services. Corprights helps organizations navigate regulatory and market complexities through a combination of expertise and innovation. Applicants can expect to work in a dynamic environment that emphasizes professional excellence and client-centric service.

* Familiarity with process modeling tools and methodologies (e.g., BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma) is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Kerala, India, and collaborate in a multicultural, client-focused environment.

title: Deputy Manager - Education Loan
description:
**Location Name:**
Thrissur New
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Acquire and convert eligible Education Loan customers through compliant counselling, disciplined funnel management, complete documentation, coordinated fulfilment and active ownership of portfolio quality.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Generate and manage leads from direct, referral, consultant, institution and partner channels.
* Counsel students and co-applicants on course, country, institution, funding requirement, repayment construct and documentation.
* Capture complete application data, customer consent and source attribution in approved systems.
* Collect and validate admission, academic, KYC, income, banking and collateral documents before login.
* Coordinate with Credit, Operations, Verification and partners to resolve queries and progress files within agreed service levels.
* Track the lead-to-login, login-to-sanction and sanction-to-disbursement funnel and record lost reasons and corrective actions.
* Communicate sanction terms, conditions and pending requirements accurately to customers.
* Maintain compliant selling, customer confidentiality, audit trails and approved communication standards.
* Support portfolio quality through appropriate sourcing, fraud vigilance and early issue escalation.
* Support portfolio quality and X-bucket management through pre-due and pre-bounce customer engagement, timely repayment reminders, follow-up on assigned overdue cases and escalation to the Sales Manager and Collections team.
* Execute assigned activities directly and maintain accurate system records.
* Escalate customer, documentation, fraud or repayment concerns promptly.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**
Decision rights
  
  

* Make day-to-day sales and customer-management decisions within approved policy, process, pricing and delegated authority.
* Prioritise and allocate customer follow-ups, including portfolio-quality and X-bucket actions, within the assigned scope.
* Escalate policy deviations, material customer impact, fraud indicators, persistent overdue cases and unresolved dependencies.
* Commercial, hiring and budget authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix.

Key interactions
  
  
Internal Sales, Product, Credit/Underwriting, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Compliance, Finance, Technology, HR and COE.
  
  
External Students, co-applicants, universities, education consultants, DSAs, referral partners and other approved service providers.
  
  
**Major Challenges**

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent customer, academic and financial information.
* Driving timely customer engagement for pre-due, pre-bounce and overdue cases while following approved conduct standards.
* Coordinating Sales, Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations to address X-bucket and early-delinquency issues.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Graduate. Relevant customer-facing, lending or financial-services experience preferred.
  
  
Critical skills and knowledge
  
  

* Education Loan customer counselling
* Sales execution and relationship management
* Portfolio-quality and X-bucket management awareness
* Customer repayment engagement and early-delinquency follow-up
* Understanding of academic, income and KYC documents
* CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline
* Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
* Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
* High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

title: Certification Manager
description:
Job Opening: Certification Officer / Manager

**Location:**
Kottayam

**Salary:**
Up to ₹60,000 per month, depending on experience

**Additional Benefit:**
Company car provided for site visits

About the Role

We are looking for a qualified and experienced
**FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) Certification Officer / Manager**
to lead the implementation of FSC certification for our smallholder farmers and company operations.

The primary objective of this role is to obtain
**Forest Management (FM) certification for smallholder farmers and Chain of Custody (CoC) certification for the company**
. The successful candidate will work closely with farmers, internal teams, and certification bodies to ensure compliance with FSC standards and facilitate a smooth certification and audit process.

This is a hands-on role that requires fieldwork, site mapping, documentation, stakeholder engagement, and a strong understanding of FSC certification requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* **FSC Certification:**
  Lead and coordinate the process of obtaining Forest Management (FM) certification for smallholder farmers and Chain of Custody (CoC) certification for the company.
* **Farmer Engagement:**
  Serve as the primary point of contact for farmers interested in participating in the FSC certification programme, including onboarding, coordination, and ongoing support.
* **Forest Mapping:**
  Conduct and coordinate mapping of all relevant farmer plots and forest sites, ensuring accurate geographical records and maps are available for certification and audit purposes.
* **Documentation and Compliance:**
  Prepare, organise, and maintain all required documentation, records, procedures, and compliance systems in accordance with applicable FSC standards.
* **Audit Coordination:**
  Liaise with FSC-accredited certification bodies, coordinate audits and site assessments, and ensure that any identified non-conformities are addressed promptly.
* **Training and Capacity Building:**
  Provide training and guidance to farmers, field staff, and other stakeholders on FSC requirements, responsible forest management, and relevant compliance procedures.
* **Chain of Custody Implementation:**
  Establish and maintain the necessary systems, records, and procedures to support the company's CoC certification.
* **Field Visits:**
  Regularly travel to farmer plots and operational sites to verify information, monitor compliance, collect data, and support certification implementation.
* **Progress Monitoring:**
  Track certification milestones, maintain farmer and site databases, and provide regular updates on implementation progress.

Candidate Requirements

* A
  **BSc in Forestry**
  or a related qualification is preferred.
* Previous experience in FSC certification, forest management certification, sustainability auditing, or certification consultancy is highly desirable.
* Experience working as an FSC auditor, supporting certification audits, or implementing FSC certification programmes will be a strong advantage.
* Practical knowledge of FSC Forest Management (FM) and Chain of Custody (CoC) standards and certification procedures.
* Experience in forest or farm mapping, GPS-based data collection, GIS tools, or geospatial mapping.
* Ability to prepare and manage technical documentation, audit records, compliance reports, and site-level data.
* Strong communication and coordination skills, particularly when working with farmers and field teams.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly between sites.
* A
  **valid driving licence**
  is essential, as the role involves frequent field visits.

What We Offer

* Salary of up to
  **₹60,000 per month**
  , depending on qualifications and relevant experience.
* Company car provided for site visits.
* An opportunity to lead the development and implementation of an FSC certification programme from the ground up.
* A field-oriented role with the opportunity to work directly with smallholder farmers and contribute to responsible forest management and sustainable supply chains.

title: Australian Migration (GSM) Documentation Specialist
description:
**Job description:**

The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Setting the Quality Standard

–Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved

–Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward

–Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it

–Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure

2. Checking Files Before Submission

–Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority

–Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements

–Gives final approval — nothing gets lodged without QA sign-off

3. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules

–Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines

–Updates the team quickly whenever rules change

–Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements

4. Improving How Things Work

–Creates clear step-by-step processes for the team to follow

–Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly

–Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening

5. Reducing Errors and Rejections

–Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from

–Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened

–Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again

–Works toward getting files right the first time, every time

6. Reporting to Leadership

–Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing

–Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends

–Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly

7. Working With Other Teams

–Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff

–Makes sure quality is not just a QA job — it runs through the whole business

–Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk

8. Training the Team

–Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills

–Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes

–Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager

9. Protecting Client Information

–Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private

–Follows all legal and company rules around data protection

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

–Has a relevant degree

–Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services

–Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years

–Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires

–Has used case management or CRM systems before

–Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus

Work Location: In person

title: Marine
description:
**Company Description**
S & O Maritime Services is an engineering, project management, and consultancy company specializing in the marine and oil & gas industries. Founded by a team of passionate and experienced professionals, the company operates branches in the United Arab Emirates and India and supports clients across marine and offshore sectors. S & O Maritime Services delivers end-to-end solutions, including engineering, technical support, project management, interface engineering, and product sourcing. The team’s diverse expertise covers Naval Architecture, Structural, Marine, Electrical Engineering, Project Management, and Surveying, enabling comprehensive, solution-oriented support. By combining advanced technology with deep industry knowledge, the company develops practical and innovative answers to complex marine and oilfield challenges.
  
**Role Description**
The Marine Equipment and Technical Publications Intern will support the engineering and consultancy teams with documentation and information management related to marine equipment and systems. This internship role is on-site and located in Aluva. Day-to-day tasks may include assisting in preparing technical manuals, equipment specifications, operation and maintenance procedures, and project reports for marine and oil & gas projects. The intern will help organize and update technical datasets, drawings, and reference materials, ensuring accuracy and consistency across publications. This role also involves collaborating with engineers and project managers to gather technical inputs, performing basic research on marine standards and regulations, and contributing to layout, formatting, and quality checks of technical documents.

* Effective collaboration skills, including the ability to work with multidisciplinary teams and seek clarification from subject matter experts.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a relevant diploma or degree in engineering, marine technology, or a related field; prior exposure to the marine or oil & gas industry is an advantage.
* Interest in developing a career in technical documentation, marine equipment support, or engineering services within the marine and offshore sectors.
